purpose: README and documentation marketing artwork; not an in-app generation sample

source.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: original photographic background plate for CaraML's developer-project cover, wide 2:1 landscape composition, ideally 2048 by 1024. Create a single beautiful sculptural cobalt-blue flower with delicate translucent overlapping poppy-like petals, macro studio photography, glowing electric-blue rims and pale ice-blue folds, natural fine petal veins. Deep ink-navy near-black seamless background (#061329). The large flower occupies the lower-right half: its luminous center at approximately 77% across and 72% down; outer petals crop elegantly through the right and bottom edges. The upper half and left half have abundant quiet dark negative space for typography that will be added later. A faint defocused blue petal glow near the bottom-left corner balances the composition without a second flower. Mood: sophisticated editorial, ethereal refracted light, dimensional organic form, luminous blue against midnight. Palette only navy, cobalt, sapphire and icy blue; no green leaves, no warm yellow center. Keep the flower's core recognizable and detailed; optical distortion will be applied later using a real shader. No text, no logos, no lettering, no UI, no border, no watermark. This is original CaraML marketing artwork; do not imitate or include any existing brand logo.

composition.layout: Compact 1600 by 560 masthead; upright CaraML wordmark and factual subtitle on the left; full-bleed flower on the right.
composition.subtitle: On-device AI with Kotlin Multiplatform
